assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission only for provided official boundaries and submitted design layers; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: Official FAR, building height, density, green ratio, setback, road redlines, rail alignments, and utility conditions are missing from the public site package and must not be fabricated.
assumptions.impact: The proposal expresses these as concept ranges or pending official confirmation only; no statutory control conclusion is claimed.

assumptions.statement: Site boundary and three key-area polygons are provisional and derived from brief/site-package/geometry/provisional_boundaries.geojson.
assumptions.impact: All area values and design layers must be recalculated when official polygons are published.

assumptions.statement: All AI scenarios, landmarks, events, policies, and operation mechanisms are conceptual suggestions for professional teams to deepen.
assumptions.impact: No scenario or operation arrangement is represented as an approved government activity or implementation commitment.

assumptions.statement: All spatial evidence and narrative facts use public or user-provided cleared sources listed in sources.json and data/source_registry.json.
assumptions.impact: Unlicensed, non-public, or unapproved materials are excluded from the submission package.

assumptions.statement: When official redlines are published, geometry/site_boundary.geojson and geometry/key_areas.geojson must be replaced, geometry regenerated, metrics recalculated, and charts, HTML, and manifest checksums updated.
assumptions.impact: Area narrative and all derived metrics remain provisional until the official polygon replacement workflow is executed.
